summary: 19-year-old man reported possibly lost in the Zapata Falls area after his girlfriend could not reach him by phone; he had a history of seizures and was dressed only in jeans and a T-shirt with sunset an hour away, so AVSAR called out a team and sent a liaison to the area; contact was made with him by cell phone at about 1758 hours -- he was unharmed, had simply kept hiking, and was unaware anyone thought him lost -- and the team was stood down.
notes: Stand-down class: AVSAR callout with liaison deployed; subject located uninjured by phone, team stood down. Parent-opened live run 997; stood-down-mission precedent ids 2381/3535.
